container_info.reasoning: The application description explicitly targets an existing React application and requests a Playwright automation test suite using Node.js. Playwright and Node.js are common choices for end-to-end testing of browser-based SPAs like React apps. The container already includes Node.js, npm/yarn, Playwright-related tooling candidates (build-essential, yarn, typescript) and frontend CLIs, so React for a web platform is the correct detection.

Install browser binaries via Playwright (playwright install --with-deps or playwright install chromium) for headless operation

steps.name: environment - install system libs and persist environment variables (safe, logged)
steps.description: Install minimal OS libraries required for headless Chromium in an idempotent, non-interactive way; log apt output to .validation/apt_install.log so failures are visible. Persist Playwright-related environment variables to /etc/profile.d only if not already set (non-destructive). Avoid globally forcing NODE_ENV unless it was not previously set. This step prepares the container for headless browser operation and ensures environment persistence across sessions.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/react-application-end-to-end-testing-suite-293562-293571/playwright_test_suite"
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE/.validation"
PKGS=(libnss3 libatk1.0-0 libatk-bridge2.0-0 libcups2 libxcomposite1 libxrandr2 libxdamage1 libxkbcommon0 libgbm1 libpangocairo-1.0-0 libpango-1.0-0 libx11-6 libxss1 fonts-liberation libxrender1 libasound2)
# Update and install non-interactively; log output for troubleshooting
sudo apt-get update -qq > "$WORKSPACE/.validation/apt_update.log" 2>&1 || { cat "$WORKSPACE/.validation/apt_update.log" >&2; exit 10; }
sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends "${PKGS[@]}" > "$WORKSPACE/.validation/apt_install.log" 2>&1 || { echo "ERROR: apt-get install failed; see $WORKSPACE/.validation/apt_install.log" >&2; cat "$WORKSPACE/.validation/apt_install.log" >&2; exit 11; }
# Persist env idempotently but non-destructively: only set vars if not already set
PLAY_ENV_FILE=/etc/profile.d/playwright_env.sh
TMP_FILE="$WORKSPACE/.validation/playwright_env.tmp"
cat > "$TMP_FILE" <<'ENV'
# Playwright environment (idempotent)
export PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=${PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH:-0}
# set CI/NODE_ENV only if unset
: ${CI:=}
[ -z "$CI" ] && echo 'export CI=true'
: ${NODE_ENV:=}
[ -z "$NODE_ENV" ] && echo 'export NODE_ENV=development'
ENV
# Write only if different to avoid overwriting
if [ -f "$PLAY_ENV_FILE" ]; then
  if ! sudo cmp -s "$TMP_FILE" "$PLAY_ENV_FILE"; then
    sudo cp "$TMP_FILE" "$PLAY_ENV_FILE"
    sudo chmod 644 "$PLAY_ENV_FILE"
  fi
else
  sudo cp "$TMP_FILE" "$PLAY_ENV_FILE"
  sudo chmod 644 "$PLAY_ENV_FILE"
fi
rm -f "$TMP_FILE"
# Validate the file exists and contains PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH
sudo grep -q PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH "$PLAY_ENV_FILE" >/dev/null || (echo "ERROR: failed to write $PLAY_ENV_FILE" >&2; exit 12)
# Record installed packages list for troubleshooting
dpkg -l "${PKGS[@]}" > "$WORKSPACE/.validation/apt_packages_installed.txt" 2>/dev/null || true

steps.name: dependencies - install Playwright, optional @playwright/test, TS tools, and browser binaries with validation
steps.description: Validate Node/npm versions, prefer npm ci when package-lock.json exists, install devDependencies (playwright and optionally @playwright/test), correctly expand extra deps, check npx availability and fallback to node_modules/.bin, run Playwright browser install, verify browser binaries across common cache locations ($WORKSPACE/node_modules/.cache/ms-playwright and $HOME/.cache/ms-playwright), and record installed package versions and logs to .validation.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/react-application-end-to-end-testing-suite-293562-293571/playwright_test_suite"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE/.validation"
# record versions early
node -v > "$WORKSPACE/.validation/node_version.txt" 2>&1 || true
npm --version > "$WORKSPACE/.validation/npm_version.txt" 2>&1 || true
# Node check
NODE_MAJOR=$(node -v | sed -E 's/v([0-9]+).*/\1/' 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
if [ "${NODE_MAJOR:-0}" -lt 16 ]; then
  echo "WARNING: Node <16 detected ($(node -v)). Playwright may require newer Node. Proceeding but tests may fail." > "$WORKSPACE/.validation/node_warning.txt"
fi
[ -f package.json ] || (echo "ERROR: package.json missing in $WORKSPACE" >&2; exit 20)
# Decide packages to install
PLAYWRIGHT_PKG=${PLAYWRIGHT_VERSION:-"playwright"}
# install @playwright/test by default unless PLAYWRIGHT_ONLY=1
if [ "${PLAYWRIGHT_ONLY:-0}" = "1" ]; then
  PLAYWRIGHT_TEST_PKG=""
else
  PLAYWRIGHT_TEST_PKG=${PLAYWRIGHT_TEST_VERSION:-"@playwright/test"}
fi
# EXTRA_DEPS for TS
EXTRA_DEPS=()
if [ -f tsconfig.json ]; then
  EXTRA_DEPS+=(typescript ts-node)
fi
# Prefer npm ci when package-lock.json exists for reproducible installs
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then
  npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --silent --no-progress 2>&1 | tee "$WORKSPACE/.validation/npm_ci.log"
else
  # Build install args dynamically and expand extras correctly
  ARGS=("-D" "--no-audit" "--no-fund" "--silent" "--no-progress")
  ARGS+=("$PLAYWRIGHT_PKG")
  [ -n "${PLAYWRIGHT_TEST_PKG}" ] && ARGS+=("$PLAYWRIGHT_TEST_PKG")
  if [ "${#EXTRA_DEPS[@]}" -gt 0 ]; then
    for d in "${EXTRA_DEPS[@]}"; do ARGS+=("$d"); done
  fi
  npm i "${ARGS[@]}" 2>&1 | tee "$WORKSPACE/.validation/npm_install.log"
fi
# Record installed package versions if present
node -e "try{const p=require('./package.json'); console.log(p.dependencies||{}); console.log(p.devDependencies||{});}catch(e){}" > "$WORKSPACE/.validation/package_json_deps.txt" 2>&1 || true
npm ls --depth=0 2>/dev/null > "$WORKSPACE/.validation/npm_ls_top.txt" || true
# Ensure npx or local bin playwright exists
if command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  PLAYWRIGHT_CMD="npx playwright"
else
  PLAYWRIGHT_CMD="$(pwd)/node_modules/.bin/playwright"
fi
# Source persisted env for browser install
[ -f /etc/profile.d/playwright_env.sh ] && source /etc/profile.d/playwright_env.sh || true
export PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=${PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH:-0}
# Install chromium binaries explicitly and log
$PLAYWRIGHT_CMD install chromium 2>&1 | tee "$WORKSPACE/.validation/playwright_install.log"
# Validate browser binaries across common cache locations
> "$WORKSPACE/.validation/playwright_browser_dirs.txt" || true
# check node_modules cache
if [ -d "$WORKSPACE/node_modules/.cache/ms-playwright" ]; then
  find "$WORKSPACE/node_modules/.cache/ms-playwright" -maxdepth 4 -type d -name "*chromium*" -print >> "$WORKSPACE/.validation/playwright_browser_dirs.txt" || true
fi
# check home cache
if [ -d "$HOME/.cache/ms-playwright" ]; then
  find "$HOME/.cache/ms-playwright" -maxdepth 4 -type d -name "*chromium*" -print >> "$WORKSPACE/.validation/playwright_browser_dirs.txt" || true
fi
# check legacy ~/.playwright or other common dirs
if [ -d "$WORKSPACE/.cache/ms-playwright" ]; then
  find "$WORKSPACE/.cache/ms-playwright" -maxdepth 4 -type d -name "*chromium*" -print >> "$WORKSPACE/.validation/playwright_browser_dirs.txt" || true
fi
# If PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH is set to a directory, record it
if [ "${PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH}" != "0" ] && [ -d "${PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH}" ]; then
  echo "${PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH}" >> "$WORKSPACE/.validation/playwright_browser_dirs.txt" || true
fi
# final check
if [ ! -s "$WORKSPACE/.validation/playwright_browser_dirs.txt" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: browser binaries not found in expected cache locations; see $WORKSPACE/.validation/playwright_install.log" >&2
  exit 21
fi
# Record installed playwright versions
( npm ls playwright --depth=0 2>/dev/null || true ) > "$WORKSPACE/.validation/playwright_version.txt"
( npm ls @playwright/test --depth=0 2>/dev/null || true ) > "$WORKSPACE/.validation/playwright_test_version.txt"

steps.name: testing - run sample Playwright tests and capture logs
steps.description: Source persisted environment into current shell (ensures non-login shells get same vars), export PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH locally, run sample Playwright tests with list reporter capturing output and exit code into .validation for troubleshooting. This step fails fast on test failures and records the exit status.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/react-application-end-to-end-testing-suite-293562-293571/playwright_test_suite"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE/.validation"
# ensure env available in this shell
[ -f /etc/profile.d/playwright_env.sh ] && source /etc/profile.d/playwright_env.sh || true
export PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=${PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH:-0}
# Ensure npx fallback
if command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  CMD=(npx playwright)
else
  CMD=("$WORKSPACE/node_modules/.bin/playwright")
fi
# Run tests and capture logs
"${CMD[@]}" test --reporter=list 2>&1 | tee "$WORKSPACE/.validation/playwright_test_run.log"
EXIT_CODE=${PIPESTATUS[0]:-0}
echo "$EXIT_CODE" > "$WORKSPACE/.validation/test_exit_code.txt"
if [ "$EXIT_CODE" -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "Playwright tests failed (exit $EXIT_CODE); see $WORKSPACE/.validation/playwright_test_run.log" >&2
  exit "$EXIT_CODE"
fi

steps.description: Perform BUILD/START/TEST/STOP lifecycle: prefer npm ci when package-lock.json exists else npm i; create index.html with a <title>; start a small node HTTP server on a free ephemeral port (fall back if 8080 busy), verify server listening via curl, run Playwright tests against the local server, stop the server cleanly using traps, and produce logs and exit codes under .validation. This provides deterministic evidence that the environment is functional.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash set -euo pipefail WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/react-application-end-to-end-testing-suite-293562-293571/playwright_test_suite" cd "$WORKSPACE" mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE/.validation" # BUILD if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --silent --no-progress 2>&1 | tee "$WORKSPACE/.validation/npm_ci.log" else npm i --no-audit --no-fund --silent --no-progress 2>&1 | tee "$WORKSPACE/.validation/npm_install.log" fi # START: ensure index.html with title exists if [ ! -f "$WORKSPACE/index.html" ]; then cat > "$WORKSPACE/index.html" <<'HTML' Playwright local server

Playwright local server

HTML fi # Choose port: try 8080 then fallback to ephemeral port via node small script PORT=8080 if ss -ltn 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $4}' | grep -q ":${PORT}$"; then # find ephemeral free port PORT=$(node -e "const srv=require('net').createServer(); srv.listen(0,()=>{console.log(srv.address().port); srv.close();});" 2>/dev/null || echo 0) if [ -z "$PORT" ] || [ "$PORT" = "0" ]; then echo "ERROR: failed to find free port" >&2 exit 30 fi fi # start server with trap-based cleanup and logging NODE_SERVER_LOG="$WORKSPACE/.validation/static_server.log" node -e "const http=require('http'),fs=require('fs');const srv=http.createServer((r,s)=>{if(r.url=='/'){s.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':'text/html'});s.end(fs.readFileSync('index.html'))}else{s.writeHead(404);s.end('not found')}});srv.listen(${PORT},'0.0.0.0');console.log('listening');process.on('SIGTERM',()=>srv.close(()=>process.exit(0)));" > "$NODE_SERVER_LOG" 2>&1 & SERVER_PID=$! cleanup(){ kill "$SERVER_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; wait "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; } trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM # wait and verify via HTTP probe for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do sleep 0.5 if curl --silent --fail "http://localhost:${PORT}/" >/dev/null 2>&1; then break fi if [ "$i" -eq 5 ]; then echo "ERROR: static server failed to respond; see $NODE_SERVER_LOG" >&2 sed -n '1,200p' "$NODE_SERVER_LOG" >&2 || true cleanup exit 31 fi done echo "$SERVER_PID" > "$WORKSPACE/.validation/server.pid" # Create a test targeting local server (uses @playwright/test if installed) if npm ls @playwright/test --depth=0 >/dev/null 2>&1; then cat > "$WORKSPACE/tests/local.spec.js" <<'JS' const { test, expect } = require('@playwright/test'); test('local server responds', async ({ page }) => { await page.goto('http://localhost:PORT_PLACEHOLDER'); await expect(page).toHaveTitle(/Playwright local server/i); }); JS sed -i "s/PORT_PLACEHOLDER/${PORT}/g" "$WORKSPACE/tests/local.spec.js" else cat > "$WORKSPACE/tests/local_basic.js" <<'JS' const { chromium } = require('playwright'); (async () => { const browser = await chromium.launch(); const page = await browser.newPage(); await page.goto('http://localhost:PORT_PLACEHOLDER'); console.log('title:', await page.title()); await browser.close(); })(); JS sed -i "s/PORT_PLACEHOLDER/${PORT}/g" "$WORKSPACE/tests/local_basic.js" fi # Ensure env present and exported in this shell [ -f /etc/profile.d/playwright_env.sh ] && source /etc/profile.d/playwright_env.sh || true export PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=${PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH:-0} # Run tests if command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1; then PLAY_CMD=(npx playwright) else PLAY_CMD=("$WORKSPACE/node_modules/.bin/playwright") fi "${PLAY_CMD[@]}" test --reporter=list 2>&1 | tee "$WORKSPACE/.validation/validation_playwright_run.log" TEST_EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]:-0} # STOP handled by trap cleanup # Record results echo "$TEST_EXIT" > "$WORKSPACE/.validation/validation_test_exit_code.txt" if [ "$TEST_EXIT" -ne 0 ]; then echo "Validation tests failed; see $WORKSPACE/.validation" >&2 exit 32 fi echo "Validation succeeded" > "$WORKSPACE/.validation/result.txt"
